Class ServiceJdkHttpClientConfiguration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.HttpClientConfiguration
io.micronaut.http.client.ServiceHttpClientConfiguration
io.micronaut.http.client.jdk.ServiceJdkHttpClientConfiguration
All Implemented Interfaces:
JdkHttpClientConfiguration, ClientContextPathProvider
@EachProperty("micronaut.http.services") @Replaces(ServiceHttpClientConfiguration.class) public class ServiceJdkHttpClientConfiguration extends ServiceHttpClientConfiguration implements JdkHttpClientConfiguration
The configuration of a service client, micronaut.http.services.<id>, that also carries the JDK settings under micronaut.http.services.<id>.jdk. The JDK settings a service does not set are those of the default client.
Since:
5.3.0
